name: Haian Riverfront Hotel Da Nang
detail: It's a nice place for shopping, and you can also walk to the Da Nang Cathedral. The Dragon Bridge is on the opposite side, so you'll need to cross the river for the show, but it's within walking distance to get back. The room is very clean and stylish as well. The staff's service is also attentive. The only downside was that the hairdryer had a weak airflow, but I would like to stay here again when I visit Da Nang.

name: Crystal Hotel

name: Grandvrio Ocean Resort Danang
detail: During my recent trip to Da Nang, what stayed with me the most at the hotel was the warmth and attentiveness of the staff, beyond the hotel facilities. My room was on the top floor of the hotel building and was very spacious with high ceilings, and the cleaning was thorough. The location facing the sea offered a pleasant view from the room, allowing me to feel like I was in a resort from the moment I woke up. Personally, I really liked the hot spring. There was a large public bath, sauna, and cold-water bath, with shampoo, conditioner, and body soap provided. Moreover, bath towels were also available, making it very convenient to go without bringing anything from the room. It was open from 6 am to 11 pm, so I could enjoy the hot spring after returning from sightseeing and go again the following morning... which was very nice. The fitness center had treadmills, cycles, benches, and was sufficient for me to get a little exercise while traveling. I was also happy that towels were provided. Outdoors, there was space for basketball and badminton. The proximity of the beach right in front of the hotel was also attractive. Compared to My Khe Beach, the ocean seemed clearer. However, since the water is not shallow, I think it's better to be cautious when entering the sea with small children. Above all, what left a strong impression were the staff. There was a Japanese manager, who was not only there during check-in and check-out. They would talk to us during breakfast every morning and promptly answered any questions or concerns we had for the day. I believe this attitude has been passed on to the rest of the staff. Everyone was very calm and consistently attentive, ensuring that guests felt comfortable throughout their stay. They remembered names, room numbers, and would often rush ahead to call the elevator for you. When I was waiting for a Grab in the lobby, they proactively checked if I was waiting for a vehicle even before I asked. All of these may seem like small gestures, but they accumulated throughout my stay, making me feel valued in this hotel. On the final day, I had a late-night flight, so after returning to the hotel in the evening, I took one last dip in the hot spring, packed my bags, and enjoyed a leisurely time until departure. I think this hotel is more about enjoying the time spent at the hotel rather than just a place to stay while sightseeing. There are many hotels with excellent facilities, but not many make you feel I want to stay again as much as this one, thanks to the approach of the staff. During this stay, I felt that the hospitality that Gran Ville Resort Da Nang values was clearly communicated to the guests. If I have friends going to Da Nang, I would definitely recommend this hotel. And I personally would like to stay here again the next time I visit Da Nang. Thank you to the staff for a wonderful stay.

name: Royal Beach Hotel
detail: The hotel is located near My Khe beach and the rooms are spacious and clean. There is a nearby pho breakfast shop that is also delicious. I booked through the app and got a better price, so it is very worth it. My family stayed in 3 rooms, and they were all good. The reception is also very friendly and comfortable, providing good service to guests. If I have the chance to come back to Da Nang, I will choose this place again.

name: Sea Near Me Hotel Danang
detail: The location is very favorable, the hotel is about a 5-minute walk to the beach, so you can comfortably swim and relax on the beach in the afternoon while reading a book. The staff is extremely friendly and cheerful. The room is large, clean, and the bed is very soft and comfortable.

name: Paris Deli Danang Beach Hotel
detail: The meals were delicious, the cleaning staff came every day, and the staff were kind. The cost performance was excellent, and I definitely recommend checking it out. It's also close to the beach, so don't miss the nightlife at Escobar Beach! I was able to watch the fire dance show for free, which became a wonderful memory. It's close to the airport, so it was fine even for late-night flights.

name: Centre Hotel
detail: It is located in the city center, making it good for city tours. Fresh towels are provided daily, and the water quality is clean, maintaining the filter well. I was a bit taken aback by the lack of a shoe cabinet, but I am satisfied with the location and breakfast for this price. The swimming pool is small.

name: Sofiana My Khe Hotel & Spa - Rooftop Pool Bar - Free 01 Draught Beer and 20-minute Spa per Room
detail: I stayed for 3 nights and had a very comfortable time. The room was very clean, well-maintained, and spacious enough to open two large suitcases. I was also pleased to have a bathtub, and the water pressure and temperature of the shower were stable and comfortable. The fact that shampoo and conditioner were provided separately, along with three types of towels (hand towels, face towels, and bath towels), is a great point for Japanese guests. Toilet paper was replenished properly every day, and the towels always had a pleasant fragrance, making them nice to use. The location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk to the beach. There are convenience stores and sports bars nearby, making it very convenient. The breakfast buffet was varied and delicious, and since it was available until 10 AM, I was able to take my time in the morning. What impressed me the most was the staff. Everyone was very kind, full of hospitality, and always greeted us with a smile. I stayed during the World Cup period, and on the day of the Japanese national team’s match, the staff reached out to us, which really warmed my heart. Thanks to their friendly and heartfelt service, my trip became an even more wonderful memory. The next time I visit Da Nang, I would definitely want to stay at this hotel again. It’s a highly satisfying hotel that I can confidently recommend to fellow Japanese guests.

name: DLG Hotel Danang
detail: There is a reason why highly rated places are so. I arrived early and requested an early check-in, and although the circumstances didn’t allow it, they did their best to let me in as soon as possible. I was assigned to the highest floor on the 14th, and even though it was a partial ocean view, I could see Mikey Beach very well. The room was very spacious, clean, and there were no problems with the bathroom drainage. I didn’t see a single bug, not even an ant. I also visited the swimming pools on the 1st and 3rd floors, and the water was very clean and spacious. I highly recommend staying here if you are in the Mikey Beach area.

name: Everland Hotel
detail: A friend arrived late at night, and I booked a one-night hotel to meet up. Considering the price, the lobby's amenities, the room size, the design, and the breakfast venue being on the 12th floor, I appreciated the view from the large window. Although the food wasn’t excessively abundant, it was more than enough for the price and was delicious. The hotel is set a bit back from the main road, which makes it quiet, and there are nearby cafes and well-reviewed restaurants that I haven't tried yet. The design and cleanliness of the pool are also excellent compared to other hotels in the same price range. If you want to stay at a hotel on a budget and save money for a massage, I think this hotel offers a high level of satisfaction. The staff were also kind. I arrived at 1:10 PM, and since the room was available from 2 PM, I took advantage of the free foot bath massage provided by a machine at the spa in the hotel while my room was being cleaned. Thank you very much!
